Prerequisites: Chemist 6

By combining the spores from strange fungi with slivers from extradimensional voids, some chemists create bombs that cause bursts of gravity capable of crushing those inside. Void bombs deal 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage, plus 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage for every 3 chemist levels beyond 1st, instead of 1d6. A creature hit by the bomb must succeed at a Reflex save against the bomb's DC. If it fails, it is knocked prone and can't get up for 1 round. If it succeeds, all of its movement speeds are reduced to 5 feet for 1 round. Other creatures within 5 feet of the bomb's target take no damage, but must succeed at a Reflex save against the bomb's DC or have all their movement speeds reduced to 5 feet for 1 round.

* This discovery modifies bombs. Discoveries marked with an asterisk do not stack; only one such discovery can be applied to an individual bomb.
